page.overview:
Who is Kathy?

Kathy was a nursery worker for Jurassic Park.

Kathy worked in the room where the new-born dinosaurs are raised to maturity before being released in the park. She may or may not have survived the Isla Nublar incident. Being in the lab, the raptors may have killed her.
